metadata.description: Claude Code mods by Matthew Winfield: Sub Meter (subscription usage with a usage graph), Worktrees (your git worktrees above the prompt) and Prompt Queue (queue messages until Claude finishes its turn)

plugins.name: sub-meter
plugins.description: Subscription usage at the bottom right: the 5-hour and weekly windows as a bar. In fullscreen, click to switch and hover for a usage graph.

plugins.name: worktrees
plugins.description: Your git worktrees above the prompt (/worktrees): branch, folder and a short Haiku summary of each, with open here, copy path and delete.

plugins.name: prompt-queue
plugins.description: Queue messages sent while Claude works and send them one by one when each turn finishes. Edit, reorder and disable queued items; switch between queue, steer and interrupt.
